title: Work Study and Human Factors
description:
Studied work measurement, method improvement, and human factors engineering, focusing on improving productivity, workplace safety, and employee well-being.

Key Topics Covered:

Work Study: Analyzing work processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

Method Study: Evaluating work methods, eliminating unnecessary activities, and improving workflow efficiency.

Time Study: Measuring task durations, evaluating work performance, and determining standard times.

Ergonomics: Designing workplaces and tasks to accommodate human physical capabilities and limitations.

Human Factors: Understanding how human capabilities, limitations, and environmental conditions influence performance, safety, and productivity.

Workplace Assessment: Evaluating working postures, repetitive movements, noise, lighting, and thermal conditions.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how work measurement, ergonomic principles, and process analysis can improve operational efficiency, reduce physical strain, and create safer and more productive work environments.
